title: SZ-00 - Ready to Start / Table Frame

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: This is a beginner-friendly Daggerheart one-shot. You do not need to know the rules ahead of time. We will learn by playing.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: This is a beginner-friendly Daggerheart one-shot. You do not need to know the rules ahead of time. We will learn by playing.

sections.title: Player bullets
items: You are hired contractors or trusted associates escorting a sealed delivery through the Goldspire Territories.
The job looks simple. It will not stay simple.
Tone: sincere fantasy adventure, corporate satire, and a little dark whimsy.
Share spotlight, ask questions, pass when needed, help other characters look cool, and respect safety tools.
GM style: clear rulings, rules-light at first, and consequences tied to the fiction.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Establish tone, expectations, and the table's shared social contract.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Script: Say the welcome plainly, then tell the table that the rules will be introduced only as needed. Confirm that everyone can see the player display and has the right handouts.
Keep it warm, confident, and short.
This is a public table: clarity and consent matter.
Checklist: All players seated; Session Zero mode selected; Safety tools ready; Handouts visible; Player display visible
